summary_en: The celebration of St Adalbert, bishop and martyr, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial on 23 April (decree of 11 July 1995, printed in full in this 1996 issue together with the proper Latin texts for Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours, pp. 190-195).
excerpt: Summus autem Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria Sancti Adalberti, episcopi et martyris, quotannis die 23 aprilis ad libitum ab omnibus peragi possit.

summary_en: The celebration of St Peter Claver, priest, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial on 9 September (decree of 8 September 1995, printed in full in this 1996 issue with the proper Latin texts, pp. 195-201).
excerpt: Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria ad libitum Sancti Petri Claver, presbyteri, quotannis die 9 septembris ab omnibus peragi possit.

summary_en: The celebration of St Peter Julian Eymard, priest, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial on 2 August (decree of 9 December 1995, printed in full in this 1996 issue with the proper Latin texts, pp. 201-206).
excerpt: Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria ad libitum Sancti Petri Iuliani Eymard, presbyteri, quotannis die 2 augusti ab omnibus peragi possit.

summary_en: The celebration of the Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary in the General Roman Calendar is raised from an optional memorial to an obligatory memorial, on the day already assigned (Saturday after the Sacred Heart); where by approved particular law it is celebrated on a different day or grade, that continues.
excerpt: Qua de re praedicta celebratio in Calendario Romano generali die iam statuto posthac inscribenda erit gradu memoriae obligatoriae, loco memoriae ad libitum, sicut nunc habetur.

celebration.name_latin: S. Ludovici Mariae Grignion de Montfort, presbyteri

summary_en: The celebration of St Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort, priest, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial on 28 April (decree printed in full with the proper Latin texts for Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours, pp. 657-662).
excerpt: decrevit ut nomen sancti Ludovici Mariae Grignion de Montfort, presbyteri, in Calendario Romano generali inscriberetur et eius memoria ad libitum quotannis die 28 mensis Aprilis ab omnibus peragi posset.

summary_en: For Belgium, Blessed Damien de Veuster, priest, is inserted on 10 May as an optional memorial throughout the nation, and as an obligatory memorial in the church of his birthplace (Tremelo) and in the church where his remains are venerated (St Anthony, Leuven). The same protocol also confirms the French and Dutch texts of the collect and second reading (p. 669), which is not recorded.
excerpt: Belgio: 10 maii, Beati Damiani de Veuster, presbyteri, memoria ad libitum in universa Natione, gradu vero memoriae obligatoriae in ecclesia loci eius nativitatis («Tremelo») et loci ubi eius exsuviae coluntur (ecclesia S. Antonii in Lovanio) (8 ian. 1996, Prot. 2430/95/L).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Albacete (Spain) is approved; the same protocol approves the Spanish texts of the Proper of Masses, Lectionary and Liturgy of the Hours (p. 677).
excerpt: Albacete, Spagna: Calendarium proprium (27 ian. 1996, Prot. 1953/95/L).

summary_en: For the archdiocese of Berlin (Germany), two celebrations are inserted in the proper calendar: Blessed Bernhard Lichtenberg on 5 November (optional memorial) and All Martyrs of the archdiocese on 8 November (obligatory memorial). One decree naming two celebrations, kept as one entry.
excerpt:
Berlin, Germania: 5 novembris, Beati Bernardi Lichtenberg, memoria ad libitum;
8 novembris, Omnium Martyrum archidioecesis, memoria obligatoria (24 iun. 1996, Prot. 755/96/L).

Congregatio Sororum a Sacra Familia de Savigliano
Calendario e Proprio (PM/PLH).
Confirmatum: die 3 augusti 1995, (Prot. 1122/95/L).
